Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The display half of the tilted-heights work: planes use the operation frame and the shared `fold_height` resolver from #2418 (merged), corners and label anchors go through `TiltedFrame::to_world`, and the text states the local distance along the tool axis (`crates/ui`, `height_display.rs`). One resolver for generation and display; no second maths path.
- Untilted planes and text keep their existing behaviour bit for bit. Invalid tilts hide the planes and show the existing named refusal - nothing draws a wrong number silently.
- `operation::region_z` uses the same folded height, so the viewport and the generator agree.
- Decision record `docs/decisions/2416-tilted-height-display.md` closes the display half of #2416 (the P3 split from #2418). Body honest about the stack: "merge #2418 first" - it is merged, and the trial merge with current main is clean.
- Body complete: `Changelog:`, `Fixes` for the display issues, conventional subject.

## Results, merged with main

Built locally by this lane in a review worktree on Windows, head `071b797ac` trial-merged with `origin/main` (local only, never pushed).

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (full) | 1087 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored |
| heights + height_memo filter (incl. the new 3 tests) | 23 + 8 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test tilt_heights` (#2418 pins re-run) | 8 passed, 0 failed |
| clippy (this lane's review agent, same tree) | clean, exit 0 |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. #2416's tab echo ("(= Z ...)"): confirm the Heights tab shows the local value for a tilted op in one screenshot before merge; the tests cover the numbers, the screenshot covers the layout.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
